entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected to the right department.
Umm... returns, I guess?
Connecting you to a Returns Specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to return something. A helmet. I think. I'm just a bit lost on how to do it.
Of course, I can certainly help you with that. Could you please provide me with your name or order number so I can pull up your account?
Oh, sure. The name is Alex Chen. I don't know the order number, the email is probably buried somewhere.
Not a problem, Alex. I'm pulling up your account now... I see an order for an Urban Commuter Helmet from about two months ago. Is that the one?
Yes, that's the helmet. I just... I don't need it.
I understand. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

Oh, I... I don't know, really. The color wasn't what I expected, I suppose. To be honest, the box is still unopened. I just got overwhelmed and forgot all about it. The website was so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Alex. I can absolutely help you with this. Let me just confirm the delivery date here. It looks like you received the item 73 days ago.
Is that bad? I'm sorry, I'm not good with this stuff.
Not at all! According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return. Since you're at 73 days and the item is in its original packaging, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was worried I was stuck with it. Getting the right gear for safety is so important, and I just want to start over.

I completely understand. It's important that you feel confident in your equipment. I'm sending a prepaid return label and instructions to the email address on file now. You'll just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Diana. You've made this very easy.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
